name: Filipino Beef Skillet (Giniling) with Potatoes, Peppers & Raisins
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add potatoes and ground beef; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel, trim, and small dice carrots; place in a medium bowl.
Peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the carrot.
When the beef is done, add veggies to the skillet; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 6-7 minutes more.
While the veggies are cooking, trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers.
When the veggies are starting to soften, add bell peppers to the skillet along with tomato sauce, raisins, soy sauce, and spices. Stir to combine, cover, and bring to a simmer.
Once simmering, reduce heat to medium and cook, stirring occasionally, until the veggies are tender and liquid is mostly absorbed, 8-10 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide skillet between plates or bowls and enjoy!
author: Mealime
